import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAXN = 500;

    static class Flow {
        static class Edge {
            int a, b, cap, flow;
            Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
                this.a = a;
                this.b = b;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.flow = flow;
            }
        }

        ArrayList<Integer>[] g;
        ArrayList<Edge> e;
        int[] d, ptr;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Flow(int n) {
            g = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            e = new ArrayList<>();
            d = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void add_edge(int a, int b, int cap) {
            Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
            g[a].add(e.size());
            e.add(e1);
            g[b].add(e.size());
            e.add(e2);
        }

        boolean bfs(int nodes) {
            Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            q.add(0);
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            d[0] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && d[nodes - 1] == -1) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int id : g[v]) {
                    int to = e.get(id).b;
                    if (d[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                        q.add(to);
                        d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[nodes - 1] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int flow, int nodes) {
            if (flow == 0) return 0;
            if (v == nodes - 1) return flow;
            for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ++ptr[v]) {
                int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (d[to] != d[v] + 1) continue;
                int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow), nodes);
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                    e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int max_flow(int nodes) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs(nodes)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfs(0, INF, nodes);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int n, t, sx, sy;
    static int[][] temp = new int[11][11];
    static boolean[][] m = new boolean[11][11];

    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, x1, y1});
        int[][] h = new int[11][11];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(h[i], INF);

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            h[x][y] = v;

            if (x > 0 && m[x - 1][y] && h[x - 1][y] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x - 1 == x2 && y == y2);
                int lim = temp[x - 1][y];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x - 1, y});
            }
            if (y > 0 && m[x][y - 1] && h[x][y - 1] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x == x2 && y - 1 == y2);
                int lim = temp[x][y - 1];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y - 1});
            }
            if (x < n - 1 && m[x + 1][y] && h[x + 1][y] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x + 1 == x2 && y == y2);
                int lim = temp[x + 1][y];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x + 1, y});
            }
            if (y < n - 1 && m[x][y + 1] && h[x][y + 1] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x == x2 && y + 1 == y2);
                int lim = temp[x][y + 1];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y + 1});
            }
        }
        return h[x2][y2];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        Flow flow = new Flow(2 * n * n + 2);
        Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        char ch;
        int k = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ch = line.charAt(j);
                temp[i][j] = t;
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else if (ch == 'Y') {
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    m[i][j] = true;
                }
                int val = (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0';
                flow.add_edge(0, k++, val);
            }
        }

        k = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ch = line.charAt(j);
                int val = (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0';
                flow.add_edge(k++, 2 * n * n + 1, val);
            }
        }

        q.add(new int[]{0, sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            temp[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x - 1][y] && m[x - 1][y])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x - 1, y});
            if (y > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x][y - 1] && m[x][y - 1])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y - 1});
            if (x < n - 1 && v + 1 < temp[x + 1][y] && m[x + 1][y])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x + 1, y});
            if (y < n - 1 && v + 1 < temp[x][y + 1] && m[x][y + 1])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y + 1});
        }

        k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int k1 = n * n;
                ++k;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; w++) {
                        ++k1;
                        if (m[i][j] && m[z][w] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t)
                            flow.add_edge(k, k1, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.max_flow(2 * n * n + 2));
        sc.close();
    }
}
